headline: Outrageous Cost of Chartering a Supertanker for Just One Day to Carry Crude Oil from the Persian Gulf to China
summary: Chartering a supertanker to carry crude oil from the Persian Gulf to China currently costs about $1 million per day, according to the report. The article describes this as a very high threshold.
why: Supertankers carry large volumes of crude oil across long routes, so their charter rates feed into the delivered cost of oil and into global energy trade economics.
